comment: Cron temporarily removed — Vercel Hobby allows only 1 run/day, not the */30 schedule this app wants. The /api/cron/scan endpoint is kept and can still be triggered manually or by an external scheduler. Scanning also works on-demand via the 'Scan' button (POST /api/scan-command). To restore automatic scanning on a Pro plan, add back: "crons": [{ "path": "/api/cron/scan", "schedule": "*/30 * * * *" }]
